plant: SEL1_ALPHA.json alpha and plant body unchanged; visible book = plant formula, H72, state all, long only
visible: plant book B-half t (cell measure) >= 2 in the pc world
rankable: pool = sel1_calib's (CR1_PC_P8 HOF top 50 + B5_DBG_REAL HOF_RANKED, dedup, V4-invalid dropped) + plant; each takes its best A-half cost0 combo of 60 at that K; plant B-half t (cell measure) rank <= 10
t_monthly: per B month cost0 bp/day; mean / (sd ddof 1 / sqrt n)
t_weekly_nw1: each B month cut into consecutive 168 h blocks from its first row, a tail under 84 h joins the previous block; per block cost0 bp/day (log1p of hourly cost0 net, as m1_ruler.settle_multi); mean / sqrt((g0 + g1) / n), g_k = sum(d_t d_t-k) / n (Newey-West, Bartlett weight, lag 1)
select: among cells passing both checks the smallest K; same K: monthly first. T_null = the NULL training run at the chosen configuration
none_pass: no cell passes -> hand back: the data does not carry sparse selection at this plant strength
excluded: real-pool B-top TS_RANK(EMA(log_close,72),72) h4 both (B t 4.2) used its B half already: reported, never nominated
